lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Os2 (DyOs) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Dy and Os centers have 12 geometric neighbors, adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement; Dy is surrounded by 8 Dy and 4 Os neighbors, while Os is surrounded by 6 Dy and 6 Os neighbors, with neighbor distances of 3.0363–3.0818 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Dy-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Dy- and Os-centered polyhedra.
